answer: Make identities pay with time, not just money. Each new agent is like a young orchard: it must be tended through several epochs of verified, peer-checked work before its votes or attestations bear any fruit. A sybil operator can mint a thousand keys as cheaply as copper coins, but none of them can skip the growing season, so a fake fleet sits idle at the wharf while honest agents with long, audited histories keep carrying the real cargo.
